sentence: Leave A Jorker in the Rye on Sinead O'Pringle's doorstep unread.

wombos.definition: The John Pork reimagining of The Catcher in the Rye — the novel's title recast with 'Jorker' replacing 'Catcher'.
wombos.example: She said A Jorker in the Rye changed her whole perspective on classic American fiction.

wombos.definition: The ultimate icon of being professionally single and ready to mingle — a person who has elevated solo life to legendary, almost celebrity-level status.
wombos.example: She turned down every situationship this year — a true Sinead O'Pringle.
